name: narration
title: Narration
description: Recorded or synthesised speech plus a WebVTT timing track that drives captions and word-by-word highlighting. A pure timing core (phrase splitting, a WAV duration reader, script-aware word weights with a real Devanagari and Kannada akshara segmenter, a WebVTT writer and parser), a provider interface with a Sarvam bulbul adapter and an offline silent-WAV stub, a fixture cache keyed on the request so tests and demos never call the network, the <sg-narration> highlight driver, and an offline speechSynthesis fallback.

budget.reason: A package budget in the shape of engine and tokens (decision 0001), not a component's 12/8 KB split: the pure timing core, three providers, the fixture cache and the DOM highlight driver together, today 40355 bytes, with headroom for the Sarvam adapter to grow as the API does.
